title: Two Shelves
focus: 询问归属、表达需要、商量共用空间
story:
At six, I go to the small shop near our building.

I buy milk, eggs, tomatoes and some bread. Tomorrow is a workday. I need something for breakfast.

When I get back, Maya’s bedroom door is closed. I can hear her talking.

I take my food into the kitchen.

There are two shelves in the fridge. The top shelf is almost full. There is some cheese, a bowl of rice and three small boxes.

The bottom shelf is empty.

That must be mine.

I put my milk, eggs and tomatoes on it. Then I put the bread on the kitchen table.

Maya comes out of her room.

“Something smells good,” she says.

“The bread’s still warm. Would you like some?”

“Yes, please.”

She gets two plates. I open the bag.

Then she sees the fridge.

“Oh. Is that your food on the bottom shelf?”

“Yes. Is that okay?”

“Sorry. I need that shelf tonight.”

My hand stops inside the bread bag.

“All of it?”

“There’s a cake coming. It’s for someone at work. It’s her last day tomorrow.”

“Oh. I didn’t know.”

“I know. I forgot to tell you.”

I look at my shopping.

“Where can I put my food?”

“Let’s see.”

She opens the fridge and moves two boxes.

“You can use the top shelf.”

I pick up the milk, but the bottle is too tall.

“It doesn’t fit.”

“Try the door.”

There is a large bottle of water in the fridge door.

“Is this yours?” I ask.

“Yes. You can take it out. It doesn’t need to be cold.”

I move the water and put my milk in its place.

The eggs and tomatoes fit on the top shelf.

“What about tomorrow?” I ask. “Can I use the bottom shelf then?”

“Yes. The cake’s leaving with me in the morning.”

“And the top shelf?”

“We can share it.”

I look at the cheese.

“So, we share the shelf, but not all the food?”

Maya smiles.

“Right. Please ask first.”

“Okay. You too.”

“Of course.”

The doorbell rings. Maya runs to get the cake. I hold the fridge open. The white box goes in, but the door comes back against my knee.

“Too big,” I say.

Maya gets down on the floor to look. “The box or the cake?”

We open the lid. The cake is yellow, with a small red chair on top. There is a lot of white paper around it.

“Why a chair?”

“The woman who's leaving sits next to me. When she has a question, she rolls her chair over to my desk. Sometimes she brings her whole lunch.”

I try to imagine the office tomorrow, with one less chair rolling about.

“Will someone new come?”

Maya takes a knife out of the drawer. “On Monday I get her pages. That's all I know.”

“And your picture? The people on the bus?”

“I'd like to show it on Friday. Here, hold this.”

I hold the lid while she cuts the box down one side. We fold the paper in. This time the fridge door closes.

“Good,” Maya says. “My first design today that everyone likes.”

“Ask the cake in the morning.”

We sit by the window with our bread.

A drop of water falls into the bucket in the kitchen.

“Tomorrow afternoon,” Maya says.

“Between two and four,” I reply.

She nods.

I pass her another piece of bread.

“This is for both of us.”

phrases.zh: 说明大小不合适或放不进去

practice.grammar: my milk 和 your milk 后面有名词；mine 和 yours 可以独立使用。说两组：This is my bag. This bag is mine. Is this your cup? Is this yours?
practice.pronunciation: 把重点放在物主上：Is this YOURS? / No, it’s MINE。每句说完稍停，模拟真的在等回答。

questions.q: Why does Maya need the bottom shelf?
questions.a: A cake for a coworker is coming.

questions.q: Where does Andy put the milk?
questions.a: In the fridge door, in place of the water.

questions.q: Do they agree to share all their food?
questions.a: No. They share the shelf and ask before taking food.

roleplay.context: 你在整理厨房，需要先问归属，再表达自己的需要。

turns.line: There’s a bag on the table.
Yes, it’s mine. Do you need the table?
turns.cue: 说你需要一点空间放食物。

turns.line: You can put your milk on the top shelf.
turns.cue: 说瓶子放不进去，问能否放冰箱门里。

practice.transfer: 换成办公室：桌上有别人的包，你需要用桌子。用三句话问归属、说明需要、请求把包放到椅子上。
practice.retell: 用四到六句讲清 Andy 买了什么、放在哪里、Maya 需要什么、两人怎样解决。
